主要内容: Home Depot (HD) reported Q1 2022 earnings, raising its full-year sales growth outlook to about 3% and mid single-digit earnings per share growth. Net sales rose 3.8% to $38.91 billion, surpassing analyst expectations of $36.72 billion. Same-store sales increased 2.2%, with U.S. sales up 1.7%. CEO Ted Decker noted inflation sensitivity was lower than expected, with average ticket prices up 11.4% and customer transactions of at least $1,000 rising 12.4%. Sales to professionals outpaced DIY projects, with kitchen and bathroom installation and building materials seeing double-digit growth. The report highlights shifting consumer behavior amid macroeconomic factors, with home remodeling as a preferred alternative to relocation. E-commerce sales declined over the past two months, indicating potential shifts in consumer spending patterns.
